name: God of War III Remastered
summary: Community Windows port packaged with your own extracted CUSA01623 game and 01.02 update. Base and update PKGs are read from your configured game files folder.

first_run.summary: Run Launch.cmd. The Windows launcher opens with the included game/ folder selected; press PLAY. Launcher settings and saves stay inside this package. Startup and gameplay are untested.

release_rules.notes: Windows releases containing gow3-windows.zip. Requires your own CUSA01623 with update 01.02.

pkgtool.description: Pinned Linux build tool used inside Portkeeper to extract your PS4 PKGs.

inputs.label: God of War III Remastered base game PKG (CUSA01623)
inputs.notes: Base game first. Package headers identify the title and base/update role; extracted title, version and executable are checked before use.

inputs.label: God of War III Remastered 01.02 update PKG (CUSA01623)
inputs.notes: Required when the base game is below 01.02. Select the separate matching update PKG; it is overlaid after the base. Omit only for a validated base dump already containing 01.02.

inputs.label: Previously extracted CUSA01623 01.02 folder
inputs.notes: Optional alternative under app data prepared/. It must pass the same title, version and eboot.bin checks; selecting new PKGs clears this alternative.

source_checks.description: Upstream still documents the required executable SHA-256
The Windows launcher still accepts a game directory from its environment
The Windows launcher still stores settings under APPDATA
Game preparation still uses the owned libc module

operations.text:
{name} {version} Windows package.
Extract the entire ZIP to a writable folder and run Launch.cmd. The launcher uses the included game/ folder; press PLAY. Play.cmd starts with saved settings.
Contains your own CUSA01623 game, updated to 01.02 from your selected PKGs. Portkeeper checked title, version and eboot.bin SHA-256. Game files were not obtained from upstream.
Keep the entire package together. Settings: data/config/gow3-launcher/settings.json. Saves, shader cache and logs: user/.
Upstream: https://github.com/{repository}
Extraction and packaging checks do not establish startup or gameplay compatibility. Record those results for this exact package.

windows.instructions: Extract all files together. Run Launch.cmd to open the launcher with your prepared game selected, then press PLAY. Use Play.cmd for subsequent starts. No manual PKG extraction is needed on the Windows PC.

saves: Using Launch.cmd or Play.cmd keeps launcher settings in data/config/gow3-launcher/settings.json and saves, shader cache and logs in user/. Directly launching the EXE bypasses these wrapper environment settings and can use the normal Windows AppData location.

windows: Vulkan 1.3-compatible GPU and current graphics driver

limitations: Only extractable PS4 package dumps are supported; this tool cannot recover missing decryption information from encrypted retail PKGs.
Your game must be CUSA01623 with version 01.02 and the executable hash documented by upstream.
The complete ZIP includes your game data and can be tens of GB. App data needs space for extraction, cached game files and the built ZIP.
Windows startup, first-launch configuration and gameplay have not been verified on a native Windows machine.
history: Packaging candidate prepared from the windows-v2.1.5 source and archive. Runtime settings are based on the upstream Windows launcher. Native Windows startup and gameplay remain untested.
